differential.what: the built verifier in LiteSVM against a reference (OpenSSL and RFC 8017 section 8.2.2 on Python integers for the signature, Python's json for the header and the claims) on tokens made from a fixed seed: tests/test_oidc_differential.py

outside_the_rule.what: payloads the test key signed that are not JSON in a value the verifier does not read; the reference refuses them all, and they are not counted in `cases`

coverage_guided.what: the cargo-fuzz targets of programs-v2/knos_oidc/fuzz, run with libFuzzer by scripts/fuzz_nightly.sh

targets.claims: any bytes, read by both copies of the claim reader and by serde_json
targets.rsa_verify: any bytes as a modulus, a digest and a signature (or an encoded message a test key signs), put to the program's rsa.rs, to big integers and to the rsa crate

coverage_guided.nightly: the fuzz-claims job of .github/workflows/program.yml, 300 seconds a target; its results are artifacts of each run (fuzz-claims: fuzz.json and fuzz_targets.jsonl; fuzz-claims-corpus; fuzz-claims-crash), not commits. No nightly run has included rsa_verify yet.

by_hand.what: one run here before the release, on the 0.3.15 source (the programs are 6eb81dd's, unchanged), 120 seconds a target
